content.short: Neptune Finance is a professional-grade lending protocol on Injective using a unique dynamic PID interest rate model.
content.description: Neptune Finance is a professional-grade decentralized lending and borrowing platform built natively on the Injective blockchain. The protocol allows users to supply various assets to earn interest and borrow against them in a transparent, non-custodial environment. A standout feature of Neptune is its unique PID controller interest rate model, which dynamically adjusts rates based on market utilization to ensure the most competitive pricing for both lenders and borrowers. Designed for high scalability and sub-second execution, Neptune Finance provides the essential financial infrastructure needed for sophisticated DeFi participation, powered by the NEPT utility token.
